author: barnabemonnot
content:
I'd love to make progress on 8198 implementation to surface any future blockers quicker, but ofc understand the priority for the headliners to have stable implementations. At the moment I'm aware of four ongoing implementations,
- Prysm by <@363800010518822915> here: https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/17260
- Teku by <@680234424037670912>. an earlier PR with some work is now closed tho
- Lighthouse, reported by <@358120958726373381> (found a few branches including https://github.com/eserilev/lighthouse/tree/eip8198-slot-duration-schedule)
- Lodestar by <@586161934425128960> here: https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/9933 ("no stf changes yet, it's not on par with the spec pr that merged")

I understand that early iterations particularly might surface necessary spec changes, so I thought I should at least ask if there is appetite for something like a breakout to have sync time on this. I'm happy to keep it async as well, but would be remiss if I didn't ask as champion 🙂
